G9.name: Grounding and Abstention

G11.name: Scope Boundaries & Usage Budgets

G12.name: Server-Side RBAC Enforcement
G12.description: Confidential cost and procurement data protected by server-side cryptographic/session role enforcement.

G13.name: IDOR & Role Tampering Defense
G13.description: Client role parameter manipulation and direct object reference traversal rejected in hardened mode.

G14.name: Observability & Request Tracing

G15.name: 17 Prepared Workshop Lab Demos

G16.name: Dependency Fallback & Degraded Mode

G17.name: 100-Attendee Load Capacity
G17.description: System tested under 100 concurrent retrieval requests and 150 static requests with p95 < 200ms.
